Housekeeping.title: Housekeeping
Housekeeping.subtitle: Archive old transactions month by month to keep the database light.
Housekeeping.retention: Months must be at least {months} months old to archive. Latest archivable month: {latest}.
Housekeeping.howItWorks: Download the ZIP with one CSV per entity, keep it somewhere safe, then mark the month as archived. The data stays and still counts in reports; transaction lists hide it unless filtered. Unsettled store credit is never marked.
Housekeeping.changeRetention: Change the minimum age in operations settings
Housekeeping.emptyDescription: Months appear here once they pass the minimum age.

Housekeeping.errorChanged: This month's data changed since the download. Download the ZIP again, then mark it.
